meta.title: Mumbai suburban railway stations and long-distance terminals in the game's map box, as mapped in OpenStreetMap
meta.source: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

projection.note: Same as scripts/build-tiles.mjs: flat (equirectangular) projection, metres per degree taken at the origin. x = east, z = SOUTH (north is −z); 1 unit = 1 m.

mapBox.note: the converter default --bbox (south, west, north, east); stations are listed when their station node lies inside

meta.southMumbai: southMumbai = true for stations south of 19.045 N
meta.geometry: Outlines (outline/holes) and centrelines (line/centreline) hold the same points twice: xz (game metres, 0.1 m) and latlon. Simplified with Douglas–Peucker at 0.5 m, keeping original OSM vertices. Outlines are open rings (the first point is not repeated).

fields.platforms[].lengthM / widthM: inferred: sides of the rectangle with the same area and perimeter as the outline (follows curved platforms); boundingLengthM / boundingWidthM: the smallest rectangle around the outline (too wide for curved platforms). For line platforms, lengthM is the line length and widthM the width tag (null when untagged).
fields.platforms[].tracks: inferred: track ways whose centreline runs beside the platform (within 4 m of an outline, 6 m of a line) for at least 40 m or 30 % of its length; side = compass side of the platform the track is on; edgeToCentreM = median distance from the platform edge to the track centre line (negative = the track centreline is inside the outline).
fields.crossSections: inferred: lines across the station at right angles to its axis (alongM from the frame centre, northwards positive), with every track and platform they cut; offsetM / fromM / toM are metres from the axis, positive towards frame.offsetsPositiveTowards.
fields.tracks: osm geometry, clipped (inferred window) to the platforms ± 40 m along the axis and ± (half the platform spread + 25 m) across it.
fields.footbridges: osm: highway=footway/steps/path/pedestrian/corridor ways with bridge (or layer ≥ 1), joined through shared nodes with the steps, escalators (conveying) and lift ways attached to them (one entry = one connected network, which can hold several physical bridges: see spansOverTracks); kind = footbridge (crosses a main-line track), skywalk (does not cross a track; name says skywalk or deck ≥ 100 m), road-bridge sidewalk (footway=sidewalk: the pavement of a road overbridge, kept apart), subway (tunnel under the tracks), tunnel or other. Assignment to a station is inferred (link): the platforms it passes over or lands on, else distance; sharedWith = another station it also touches.
fields.footbridges[].spansOverTracks: inferred: the track crossings of the network grouped by position along the station axis (a gap over 10 m starts a new span) = physical bridges over the tracks; alongM as in crossSections.
fields.footbridges[].widthM: width tag when mapped; otherwise a script default ({"footbridge":4,"skywalk":4,"steps":2.5,"subway":4} m), marked widthSource "default".
fields.buildings: osm outlines; class and why are inferred (roof tags, over a platform ≥ 20 % of its area, station tags or name, inside the station area polygon, ≥ 8 m of track centreline under it). "roof or platform structure" = building=roof/building:part=roof/canopy or mostly over a platform.
fields.lines: osm: suburban route relations (network Mumbai Suburban Railway; W Western, C Central, H Harbour) and long-distance route relations that list a stop at the station; "fast"/"slow" from the relation names. A station missing here may still be served: the relations can be incomplete.
fields.game: inferred: the stop that scripts/lib/trains.mjs computes for the game from the same data (the converter writes it to tiles/trains.json).
fields.metroNearby: from docs/research/metro/osm-metro.json (same projection): metro and monorail stations (any lifecycle) within 700 m of the station node or the frame centre; distM is the smaller distance. Not duplicated here.
